trigger.description: A same-UID daemon peer calls a registered workspace-bound method such as ee.daemon.context without a non-empty workspace_id, or with a workspace_id that does not match the daemon's bound workspace. The dispatcher refuses the method with a structured authorization error instead of allowing every authenticated peer to call every method.
trigger.invocation: ee.daemon.context RPC sent over the UDS socket with missing, blank, or mismatched workspace_id
